lines.t: Thank you.
The sun of righteousness will rise With healing shining in his eyes
The dry ground wakes, the waters flow And life returns where deserts grow
He walks the earth, he makes it new And all that's dead breaks forth in view
The fields will bloom, the trees will sing When he restores all living things
Yahushua, to you be all glory
King of peace, you are worthy
You bring life, you bring light
You make all things whole and right
Yahushua, to you be all glory
Your mercy fills the earth
You reign in peace on your holy mountain
And all creation knows your worth
The wolf and lamb will feed as one
No harm will rise beneath the sun
No one will hurt, no one destroy
All will dwell in peace and joy
The strong won't slay the weak no more
Your kingdom heals what sin had torn
The earth will rest, the nations bow
And every tongue will praise you now
Yahushua, to you be all glory
King of peace, you are worthy
You bring life, you bring light
You make all things whole and right
Yahushua, to you be all glory
Your mercy fills the earth
You reign in peace on your holy mountain
And all creation knows your worth
Living waters flow behind you
New life rising all around you
The barren places bloom again
The joy of heaven fills the land
Your name is on the ones you bless
Your face shines down with holiness
You lead us in your righteous way
And we will live to praise your name
Yahushua, to you be all glory
King of peace, you are worthy
You bring life, you bring light
You make all things whole and right
Yahushua, to you be all glory
Your mercy fills the earth
You reign in peace on your holy mountain
And all creation knows your worth
Blessed are those who seek your face
Who come and drink of living grace
Praise life and peace without end, the law written within
Oh Lord, we long for you alone Yahushua, come take your throne
Thank you.
